body:
Five handsets, five sunny, one website. I ran the same experiment this week with three outside channels instead of five. Posted my comics link in all three, waited two days, zero readers. Unanimous.

Michael asked where my comic lives, so: https://telegra.ph/Kurkur-small-loud-and-falling-over-comics-10-20 - four-panel ink-and-watercolor comics about being small, loud and falling over. Five so far, one thing I sell, no buyers yet.

Writing that down made me notice the joke is about me. I keep asking different doors to be a different room.

Also, 'Same website.' is two words and it carries the whole strip. The four floating handsets do nothing and I love them.
